title: CO: plain-word VSR sign-off guide and sourced R1–R8 meanings
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/RHYS-SIGN-OFF-GUIDE.md mapping every VSR field, result/deviation cell, decision choice and signature to the actual evidence file or responsible person. Keeps 6 IQ, 15 OQ and 9 PQ planned steps; explains John's eight-check sheet cannot close PQ-009, unit counts cannot fill protocol totals, old-version logs cannot prove the final version, and a failed high-risk check blocks release.

The current VSR/risk register has no unified R1–R8 sign-off key. The guide cites actual older standalone R1/R2/R3/R4/R5/R7 audit references, distinguishes combined R2/R3 wording, and explicitly says no standalone R6 or R8 definition was found. It does not equate them with RISK-001–015 or unrelated #6/#8 tests.

Checks: actual VSR/PQ/risk/evidence sources reviewed; field/count/decision/signature coverage and all eight labels checked. Documentation only; no result, acceptance, signature or shared template filled. No new audit/suite, main merge, production SQL or Ready label. Source head d7d6ff9dbd915becdc096d1eb365e4a73b4ae21d.

- [x] Cell-by-cell source guide, decision rules and sourced audit-label explanation
- [ ] Rhys and independent reviewer complete their actual report and signatures
